articles.title: Coinbase Teases 1:1-Backed Tokenized U.S. Stocks With On-Chain Dividends

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong called Monday for an overhaul of the U.S. accredited-investor framework, arguing that wealth-based gatekeeping concentrates private-market gains among the already wealthy. He proposed replacing the net worth and income test with a financial literacy exam, or removing
articles.title: Coinbase CEO Armstrong Calls Accredited-Investor Rules a 'Regressive Tax'

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Humanity Protocol has announced a full token migration and 1:1 airdrop of a new H token after the June 8 exploit that drained approximately $36 million.
articles.title: Humanity Protocol Launches New H Token Airdrop After $36M Exploit

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: BlackRock listed the iShares Bitcoin Premium Income ETF (BITA) on Nasdaq, overlaying a covered-call strategy on IBIT to generate monthly income while capping upside participation.
articles.title: BlackRock Launches BITA, a Covered-Call Bitcoin ETF Designed to Generate Monthly Income

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Robinhood is cutting roughly 10% of its full-time employees in a corporate restructuring CEO Vlad Tenev has framed as a push for a high performance culture, with $28 million in charges expected in Q2 2026.
articles.title: Robinhood Cuts 10% of Workforce, Takes $28M Restructuring Charge

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Kraken and Coinbase each launched perpetual futures products Monday, with Kraken going live on CFTC-regulated crypto contracts via Bitnomial and Coinbase introducing four thematic equity-index perpetuals on US soil.
articles.title: Kraken and Coinbase Bring Perps Onshore as US Derivatives Markets Shift

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Paradigm has led a roughly $9 million round in El Dorado, the stablecoin-powered payments app that has signed up more than a million users across Latin America. The bet extends the venture firm's push into dollar-rails for emerging markets.
articles.title: Paradigm Leads $9 Million Round in Latin American Stablecoin App El Dorado

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Standard Chartered Global Research initiated coverage of Uniswap, with Geoff Kendrick framing the decentralized exchange as the trading hub for tokenized real-world assets and setting a $100 UNI price target for end-2030, roughly 40x current levels.
articles.title: Standard Chartered Sets UNI 2030 Price Target at 40x Current Levels

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: A single dominant wallet offloaded roughly 92% of SIREN's total supply across two days, collecting $64.8 million in Tether and gutting the BNB Chain AI token.
articles.title: SIREN Token Crashes 95% in a Week After Whale Sells 670M Tokens for $64.8M

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: The Layer 1's gasless stablecoin design pushed transfer throughput to nearly $65 billion since June 10, recasting Sui as a fee-free settlement rail for institutional and agentic payments.
articles.title: Sui Processes $65 Billion in Stablecoin Transfers in Five Days After Zeroing Out Fees

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Bitcoin climbed past $67,000, its highest level in roughly two weeks, after President Trump declared the US-Iran deal "complete" and authorized reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Oil fell about 4% and around $150 million in crypto short positions were liquidated.
articles.title: Bitcoin Tops $67,000 to Two-Week High After Trump Declares US-Iran Deal Complete and Hormuz Reopening

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: Ventuals froze its OpenAI and Anthropic pre-IPO markets at 24-hour average prices and is returning deposited HYPE to users as the team folds into another Hyperliquid-ecosystem project.
articles.title: Hyperliquid-Based Ventuals Winds Down On-Chain Pre-IPO Markets

articles.author: The Defiant Team
articles.description: An attacker exploited a proof-verification flaw in Aztec Connect's abandoned RollupProcessorV3 contract to withdraw roughly $2.1 million, including 909 ETH, from a privacy bridge that Aztec Labs shut down three years ago and can no longer control.
articles.title: Aztec Connect Drained of $2.1M Through Deprecated Contract Three Years After Shutdown

articles.description: The on-chain options and structured product protocol Thetanuts Finance was exploited for $2.1 million. Security firm Blockaid published the exploit transaction and exploiter address shortly after the attack.
articles.title: Thetanuts Finance: $2.1M Attack, Partial White-Hat Recovery

articles.description: The partnership routes Ondo Global Markets equity tokens into Exodus's non-custodial app on Solana, putting a full tokenized-equity menu inside a self-custody wallet. US users are excluded.
articles.title: Exodus Puts 200-Plus Tokenized Stocks and ETFs Inside Its Self-Custody Wallet via Ondo
